scope: Compile every retained original demo through the unified root Bazel graph and qualify the named host/binding/operator interfaces. This does not claim every demo trajectory ran or complete API/domain separation.

runtime.source_reconciliation: Earlier receipt snapshots have exact reviewed source deltas in the independent index; they are not claimed identical to the final source snapshot.
runtime.mpi_scope: Real isolated single-rank preCICE validator with three ordered hashed inputs; existing two-rank message regression with no positional inputs. No coupled physical trajectory.

limits: Original GUI/GPU demo trajectories require separate asset and resource admission.
The broader inherited unit-test suite is retained but is not wholly qualified by this milestone.
Independent FEA/MBD implementation linkage and complete API renaming remain follow-up work.
PythonOCC profile covers the 57 required real module targets, not every upstream wrapper family.

disk_audit.before_deletion: Confirm exact identities and lack of live dependencies. Preserve accepted crash archives, videos, frozen binaries, source worktrees and all failure receipts.
